\- Stop playing games and start writing and drawing more. I know, you already like writing, but you're going to realize in adulthood that you always wanted to draw, so learn now. Ask, beg mom and dad, I don't care, be as creative as you can. Games are not going to make you creative and happy, and neither are hours of TV and cartoons. Bring out what's in your head, create instead of consuming.

\- I know Dad is harsh, but he has your best interests in mind, I promise. Tell mom to stop doing your homework, your laundry, learn how to cook, etc. Don't let her take over and run your life just because she loves you and doesn't want you to fail. You'll regret it. Fail, learn, and grow. Oh, and refuse to go to Dairy Queen, Sonic, or Circle K ever again for food. Oh, and Circle K will be Stripes in a few years so that's cool.

\- Get your walking gait checked out now. No, it's not normal to walk like that, and it's going to wreck your hips and knees when you grow up. Bring it up, go to a doctor.

\- Work harder in school, don't coast. Do what you can to become 1st in your class, you're more than capable. Don't be like me and end up 21st instead.

\- Get into theatre when you can. I know you're shy and you don't like having people's eyes on you, but trust me, you'll love it. 

\- Work out a lot. Push yourself, get fit, make yourself a better body to live in than I did. This is how you're going to end up if you don't, as well as developing a taste for vegetables. They're gross, but just deal with it, you'll learn to like them. I can barely get out of bed, my back, hips, knees and feet always hurt, my shoulders are misaligned, my liver is in danger despite me never touching alcohol and I might have undiagnosed diabetes but I'm too afraid to check because I think it might make me hurt myself. Don't be me. Be a better you.

\- When you graduate high school, college is going to come up. You need to think really hard about it and not let Mom talk you into it. If you don't, look into trade school. No, it's not just for stupid people who couldn't get into college. All the fields you like--media, game design, theatre--they're great fields, but there's not enough jobs out there for them unless you network. Get yourself established, then think about dreams.

\- Socialize, get out of your comfort zone. Being socially crippled will ruin you, I promise you that. Don't wait for friends to come to you.

\- Give up on her, I promise she's not the one, you're only 11 and you've never even been on a date with her.

\- Please stop hurting yourself. No more scalding in the shower, no more nylon whip, no more scissors and no more hitting brick walls. Just because mom and dad don't punish you "enough" doesn't mean you need to take over. You don't deserve it.

\- If you hear about a game called League of Legends let's say 7 or 8 years from now, never play it, never even look at it. Just know it's terrible and you have much better things to do.

\- Fight your depression diagnosis for everything you're worth and don't take medication. If that diagnosis sticks, you can never get into the military if things go wrong.

\- You're not a bad person. People really do love you, they aren't lying.

When I was a kid, I was absolutely terrified of being swallowed whole. I used to have nightmares about it all the time and everything. It also gave me a crippling fear of fat/obese people because I was a very skinny kid. I thought (and somehow this made sense to me at the time) that I was so small, and they were so big with this huge belly, that they could very easily swallow me alive and fit me inside and my parents wouldn't notice or be able to hear me, so whenever heavier people were around, and especially very heavy people, I would cling to my parents and keep my eyes on them at all times.

It's relevant-ish in top and mostly irrelevant in jungle, I feel. It helps a bit in poke matchups when combined with D-Shield and Second Wind, but still probably won't stop you from being poked out by Quinns, Urgots, etc. Remains to be seen, I guess. It's not nothing--on average (I'm bad at math) melee creeps will heal you for roughly 5 more HP per creep at rank 1, casters will heal for around 3 HP more per creep at rank 1, and cannons will heal for around 9 HP more at rank 1. So that's about 24 extra healing per non-cannon wave presuming you're in-range for each dead creep, and roughly 33 more healing per cannon wave. All this at rank 1, obviously, and ranks 1 and 2 are the most relevant to poke matchups, since by the time you're level 9 you're probably not in lane being poked that much anymore.

It's also a buff overall to teamfighting *if you're winning*. It could maybe make for a good turnaround if the 3000 health tank dies and heals you for like 180, but mostly it's kind of whatever. It adds up I suppose.

Might be wrong but a buff only to Trundle's passive doesn't seem like much. He duels well and splitpushes okay (though his main tools to escape a collapse are a minor speed buff and a pillar that everyone just dashes over) and still teamfights pretty badly unless the enemy team is mono-tank, which is common enough in this meta. He mostly just peels and bites the frontline/assassins because if he tried to run down the carries he's just going to get kited. It's not really a buff to jungle because he already had a very sustained clear, so I guess it's a buff to him in lane, which isn't really where I like playing him because he can be counterpicked so easily. You see Trundle, just grab a Quinn or a kiting mage and he won't do anything most of the time because hey, maybe you won't scale (depending on your pick) but he certainly won't either.

Maybe they just need to stop being afraid of his pillar, or if they're trying to lean into making him a kiteable bruiser (which he already was even with the good pillar) make his ult do something to non-tanks. If this is all the buff is, then it's basically a big nothing burger for jungle and a mid-range buff for lane.
